model_architecture: TF-IDF (1-2 ngrams, sublinear TF) + Soft-Voting Ensemble (Logistic Regression + Random Forest)
dataset_note: Trained on a clearly labeled 102-sample multi-channel demonstration dataset covering SMS, Email, URL, WhatsApp, Social Media, and Payment Request scenarios. Predictions are combined with transparent channel-specific heuristic rules and never claim 100% certainty.
